annotations.title: Check if a phone supports eSIM

description: Use this when the traveler asks whether their phone or tablet can use an eSIM, or before they buy if the device is unclear. Pass the model as they wrote it, e.g. 'iPhone 12', 'Galaxy S21', 'Pixel 7a'. Returns supported, likely, not_supported or unknown, with the reason and how to confirm on the device.

device.description: Phone or tablet model, e.g. 'iPhone 13 mini'.

name: check_device_compatibility
